messages:
rina: Drafted v1.7.0 release notes and pushed examples for TS + Python. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1401
omar: quick scan — examples look up-to-date but changelog index links to 'Embed streaming' and 'Adaptive routing' jump to top of page on staging.
julie: saw that too. linkcheck on preview showed two missing anchors.
docs-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-1401--docs.redwood.com — linkcheck FAILED (2 broken anchors)
omar: output:
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #embed-streaming
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing
rina: probably the markdown anchor plugin changed slug rules during the last dependency bump. I'll add a known-issue line to the release notes: "Changelog index anchors may behave unexpectedly on staging due to heading ID changes; workaround: use direct permalinks or page search."
julie: can we add a small slug normalization and redirects so published links don't break? I can open a tiny PR with a Node slugifier + redirects table.
omar: please do, and add ETA to the note (fix expected in next deploy, ~30-60m).
docs-bot: rina merged PR 1401 into main. Redirects PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1402
julie: added redirects for the two anchors in PR1402 and a short migration note in the changelog. QA on preview shows anchors resolving via redirects.
rina: updated release draft with Developer notes (snippet diffs, migration tips) and the known-issue with ETA. ready for final signoff.
omar: lgtm — publishing after PR1402 merges. Closing thread unless linkcheck resurfaces issues.
